sources: Opus: Etch Figure (6-star Arts Unit), skill 3 "Suppression: Tillite Etchings": "When the wielder's battle skill applies Nature Infliction, other operators in the team gain Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up} for {duration}s. For every enemy suffering from Nature Infliction applied by the said battle skill, other operators in the team gain bonus Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up2}, up to a max of +{spell_dmg_up2*max_stack}. Effects of the same name cannot stack." SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_funnel_0006: spell_dmg_up 0.05 (L1) to 0.14 (L9), spell_dmg_up2 0.02 to 0.056, duration 15, max_stack 3.

rmxlinux Json/SkillData sk_wpn_funnel_0006 passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 30 + CheckSkillType [2] (the wielder casts a battle skill) → child buff buff_wpn_funnel_0006 on the wielder (maxTriggerCnt 1: once per cast). That buff listens to abilityEvent 126 (an infliction the wielder applies) with CheckSpellInflictionType mask 8 (Nature), CheckSkillCastId (the same cast) and CheckOriginSkillType [2], merges the targets, counts them (≤ max_stack) and creates buff_wpn_funnel_0006_valid (attributes 51–54, formulaItem 5: spell_dmg_up + count × spell_dmg_up2; duration; stackingType 1 priority spell_dmg_up) on the team except the wielder (ExcludeOwnerValidator). Same pattern as Delivery Guaranteed (wpn_funnel_0011), whose order (before the hit's damage) fixtures/zmdlogs-4e5e1390085e.json confirms; here the wielder doesn't get the buff, so the order only matters for teammates' hits in the same frame.

ATK + atk_up (cardAttributeModifier) and the Will / Nature DMG lines are in the stat panel. toggleBuffs buff_wpn_lance_0003 (ATK + atk_up while CheckCurHpRatio ≥ hp_ratio, a key sk_wpn_funnel_0006 lacks) is left out: inert until in-game test 75's variant settles whether a missing key reads 0 (Ardelia U2; if it does, ATK +19.6% more at L9). Fits a Nature operator whose battle skill inflicts Nature (Gilberta's explosion); Ardelia's battle skill inflicts nothing. docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0025_ardelia.md W1–W3.

buffs.label: Tillite Etchings: teammates' Arts DMG
buffs.note: spell_dmg_up + min(targets, max_stack) × spell_dmg_up2; one enemy: 0.14 + 0.056 = 0.196 at L9. Not on the wielder (ExcludeOwnerValidator).

triggers.note: abilityEvent 126 with Nature mask and the battle skill as origin, once per battle-skill cast (maxTriggerCnt 1). An infliction that reacts at once isn't an inflictionApplied (in-game test 35's question).
